lines.en: label makotowinterbeach3:
scene clearnightsky
Neither Makoto nor I say anything for the first few minutes of our walk down the coast.
lines.zh: 沿着海岸走的前几分钟，Makoto 和我谁都没说话。

lines.en: The reason for this being that, in the transition to night, the sky seems to have turned rather extravagant.
lines.zh: 原因是在入夜的过渡中，天空似乎变得格外华美。

lines.en: Not to say it isn’t extravagant to begin with. I mean, it blankets the entire world.
lines.zh: 不是说它一开始就不华美。我是说，它笼罩着整个世界。

lines.en: Strike that, it blankets the entire universe.
lines.zh: 收回，它笼罩着整个宇宙。

lines.en: But I suppose at some point it stops being the sky and turns into space.
lines.zh: 不过我想，在某个节点上，它就不再是天空，而变成了太空。

lines.en: I’m sure there’s a scientific answer to when exactly that is, and I’m sure Makoto knows it because she’s a fucking genius-
lines.zh: 我确信这有个科学的答案，也确信 Makoto 知道——因为她是个该死的天才——

lines.en: But I don’t care enough to ask.
lines.zh: 但我没那么在乎，懒得问。

lines.en: Because whatever the answer is wouldn’t make much of a difference to me.
lines.zh: 因为不管答案是什么，对我来说都不会有多大区别。

lines.en: And it wouldn’t fill the gaps in conversation so noticeably empty that we can hear each other breathing over the light movement of the ocean water.
lines.zh: 它也填不上对话里那些空得刺眼的缝隙——空到我们能透过海水轻微的涌动，听见彼此的呼吸。

lines.en: In a drama film, or even something less moving like a romantic comedy, this would be a moment for our hands to gently brush up against one another.
lines.zh: 在一部剧情片里，或者哪怕是更不动人的浪漫喜剧里，此刻都该是两人的手轻轻擦过彼此的时候。

lines.en: There would be a closeup of our fingers awkwardly tangling together before becoming laced and locking into place.
lines.zh: 会有个特写：我们的手指笨拙地缠在一起，然后扣紧，锁死在那个位置。

lines.en: But instead, we walk shoulder to shoulder, not coming into direct contact because: A - We’re not allowed to this weekend, and B - We don’t want to.
lines.zh: 可我们只是并肩走着，没有直接接触，因为：一——这个周末不允许；二——我们不想。

lines.en: Or at least I don’t want to.
lines.zh: 至少我不想。

lines.en: I don’t know what Makoto wants...And I think I’ve made that pretty apparent over the last half day...
lines.zh: 我不知道 Makoto 想要什么……而我想，过去半天里我已经表现得相当明显了……

lines.en: scene makotounderstars1
: Sensei...don’t you think this is a little strange?
lines.zh: : 老师……你不觉得这有点奇怪吗？

lines.en: : Not really.
lines.zh: : 不觉得。

lines.en: : I guess it could just be me but...the sky seems rather...colorful tonight.
lines.zh: : 也许只是我这么觉得，不过……今晚的天空似乎格外……五彩斑斓。

lines.en: : Do you really not see it?
lines.zh: : 你真的没看见吗？

lines.en: : I see it.
lines.zh: : 我看见了。

lines.en: : It reminds me a little of the end of the world.
lines.zh: : 它让我想起一点世界末日的样子。

lines.en: scene makotounderstars2
: Huh. I guess it {i}is{/i} like something out of a movie. But I don’t know if I’d compare it to something like the world ending.
lines.zh: : 嗯。{i}确实{/i}有点像电影里的画面。但我不知道自己会不会把它比作世界末日之类的。

lines.en: : I feel like that would be a little more...red.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那样的话应该更……红一点。

lines.en: : Hey, do you remember what we were talking about right before we left by any chance?
lines.zh: : 嘿，你还记得我们出来之前在聊什么吗？

lines.en: scene makotounderstars3
: That’s a weird question. Why do you ask?
lines.zh: : 这问题真奇怪。你为什么问这个？

lines.en: : I feel like we’re forgetting something important.
lines.zh: : 我总觉得我们忘了什么重要的事。

lines.en: : I don’t feel like that, but...weren’t we discussing your poor treatment of me?
lines.zh: : 我没这种感觉，不过……我们不是在讨论你对我有多差吗？

lines.en: : Unless you’re referring to the Miku situation, because we discussed that as well.
lines.zh: : 除非你说的是 Miku 那件事，因为那个我们也讨论了。

lines.en: : But nothing else? Nothing that was mentioned right before your head started hurting?
lines.zh: : 但没别的了？你开始头痛之前提到的那些，也没有？

lines.en: scene makotounderstars4
: What’s this all about? Why would you wait until we’re completely isolated to start being weird?
lines.zh: : 这到底是怎么回事？你为什么非要等到我们完全独处了才开始犯怪？

lines.en: : You should at least do these things in front of Miku so I can have {i}some{/i} form of protection in the event of you going postal.
lines.zh: : 你至少该在 Miku 面前做这些事，这样万一你发疯，我还能有{i}点{/i}保护。

lines.en: : When have I ever gone “postal” before?
lines.zh: : 我什么时候发过疯？

lines.en: : I just wanted to see if there was something we’re forgetting.
lines.zh: : 我只是想看看我们是不是忘了什么。

lines.en: : Well, either you’re going insane or simply misremembering, because there are only a few things left I wanted to talk to you about this weekend.
lines.zh: : 那要么你是疯了，要么就是记错了，因为这个周末我想跟你说的事只剩下几件了。

lines.en: : We’re not done with that already?
lines.zh: : 我们还没聊完吗？

lines.en: scene makotounderstars5
: Of course we’re not done...
lines.zh: : 当然还没完……

lines.en: : I have to catch up on months of you dismissing me. That can’t be done over the course of one or two hours.
lines.zh: : 你冷落了我好几个月，我得把它们补回来。那一两个小时可补不完。

lines.en: : How many hours will it take, exactly?
lines.zh: : 具体要多少小时？

lines.en: : Why? If you’re worried about leaving Miku on her own, I’m sure she’ll be fine.
lines.zh: : 为什么问这个？如果你担心把 Miku 一个人留下，我确信她没事的。

lines.en: : The inn is a lot quieter than our dorm is, after all.
lines.zh: : 毕竟旅馆比我们宿舍安静多了。

lines.en: : That’s not it. But while we’re on the topic, if we come back to the room and find her hair all over the floor, I’m not going to be of much assistance.
lines.zh: : 不是因为这个。不过既然说到这儿，如果我们回房时发现她的头发掉了一地，我可帮不上什么忙。

lines.en: scene makotounderstars6
: You’re not very good with crises, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不太擅长处理危机，是吧？

lines.en: : I’m not.
lines.zh: : 是不擅长。

lines.en: : It’s rather unfortunate as well since they seem to be following me around lately.
lines.zh: : 这也挺不幸的，因为最近危机似乎一直缠着我。

lines.en: : Well, when you live your life getting closer than you’re supposed to with [teenage]girls, things like that are going to happen.
lines.zh: : 嗯，当你过着这种跟[teenage]女孩亲近得过界的生活，这种事迟早会发生。

lines.en: : I suppose you should just be thankful that I’ve been nothing but stable and unobtrusive thus far.
lines.zh: : 我想你该庆幸，到目前为止我一直都很稳定、也不碍事。

lines.en: : Sure. Except for that one time your mind broke and I slammed you up against a locker.
lines.zh: : 当然。除了那一次你精神崩溃，我把你按在储物柜上。

lines.en: scene makotounderstars7
: I’m sorry, what?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你说什么？

lines.en: : Is this one of your weird, perverted fantasies? Because I already told you no sex and I will not be lured into wanting it in the middle of the beach.
lines.zh: : 这又是你那种变态幻想吗？我都说了不做爱，我不会在海滩中央被勾引得想要。

lines.en: : It happened.
lines.zh: : 真的发生过。

lines.en: : It was right before the Christmas party, if I'm remembering correctly.
lines.zh: : 如果我没记错的话，是在圣诞派对前不久。

lines.en: : That’s simply not possible.
lines.zh: : 那根本不可能。

lines.en: : I haven’t used my locker since the[school] year started.
lines.zh: : 从[school]年开始我就没用过我的储物柜了。

lines.en: : I don’t even think I remember my combination.
lines.zh: : 我甚至觉得我连密码都不记得了。

lines.en: : Well then where do you keep all of your stuff?
lines.zh: : 那你把东西都放哪儿？

lines.en: scene makotounderstars8
: Your office.
lines.zh: : 你的办公室。

lines.en: : I mean, that {i}is{/i} where most of my time is spent, after all.
lines.zh: : 我是说，反正我大部分时间都耗在{i}那儿{/i}。

lines.en: : It’s not like I have much anyway. Just my shoes and my gym clothes, really.
lines.zh: : 反正我也没多少东西。就我的鞋和运动服而已。

lines.en: : You’re...keeping your gym clothes in my office?
lines.zh: : 你……把运动服放在我办公室？

lines.en: : Don’t worry. I keep them hidden, so it’s not like anyone is going to find them.
lines.zh: : 别担心。我藏起来了，不会有人找到的。

lines.en: : Good. Because I have no idea how I’d even begin to explain that.
lines.zh: : 很好。因为我完全不知道该怎么解释。

lines.en: : I give you permission to tell anyone who happens to find out that you’re just obsessed with me. I don’t mind.
lines.zh: : 我允许你告诉任何碰巧发现的人，说你只是对我痴迷而已。我不介意。

lines.en: : It’s not like I’m all that popular in the first place, so I don’t have much to lose.
lines.zh: : 反正我本来也不怎么受欢迎，没什么好失去的。

lines.en: : What do you mean you’re not popular?
lines.zh: : 什么叫你不受欢迎？

lines.en: scene makotounderstars9
: I mean that since {i}someone{/i} I know spends all of his time goofing off and not managing his class, the fact that I {i}do{/i} makes me unpopular by default.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，既然我认识的{i}某个人{/i}整天摸鱼、不管班上的事，那就只能由我来管，而{i}我这么一管{/i}，自然就不受欢迎了。

lines.en: : It’s less a matter of people disliking me and more just...being annoyed by me for ensuring that they don’t slack off too much before standardized testing.
lines.zh: : 与其说是大家讨厌我，不如说是……他们烦我，因为我确保他们在标准化考试前不会偷懒过头。

lines.en: : I’ve even been confronted by a few of them before due to how close people seem to think we are with one another.
lines.zh: : 甚至有几个人还因为别人觉得我们关系很亲近而找上我。

lines.en: scene makotounderstars10
: Which, not to make you feel bad or anything, was kind of a slap in the face when I know our relationship has been almost entirely one-sided.
lines.zh: : 我这么说不是想让你难受，但当我清楚我们的关系基本是单方面的，那感觉就像被扇了一巴掌。

lines.en: : There’s no need to reiterate your position, Sensei. You took care of that back in the room.
lines.zh: : 你不必重复你的立场，老师。你在房间里已经说得很清楚了。

lines.en: : Kind of.
lines.zh: : 算是吧。

lines.en: : And besides, things are going to get better from now on. That’s why I’m telling you all of these things.
lines.zh: : 再说，从现在起一切都会变好的。所以我才把这些都告诉你。

lines.en: : What’s in the past will always remain in the past. There’s no point in digging any of it up again if it’s just going to make you feel upset.
lines.zh: : 过去的事就永远留在过去。如果把它挖出来只会让你难过，那就没必要再挖。

lines.en: : There’s enough misery in this world for everyone to help themselves to seconds. Taking any more of that would just be greedy.
lines.zh: : 这世界上的苦难足够每个人再添一碗。再多拿就太贪心了。

lines.en: : You know, any time I start to think about how different you are, I feel like one thing you say drags you back to my level.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，每当我开始觉得你有多与众不同，你总会说出一句话，把自己拉回我这个层次。

lines.en: : Good. There’s that equal footing I was talking about earlier.
lines.zh: : 很好。这就是我之前说的平等地位。

lines.en: : If we’re on the same level, you won’t be able to look down on me. And I won’t feel the unending pressure of having to look up to you.
lines.zh: : 如果我们站在同一高度，你就无法俯视我。而我也不会一直承受着必须仰视你的那种无止境的压力。

lines.en: : Everyone wins.
lines.zh: : 人人都赢。

lines.en: : Well, almost everyone.
lines.zh: : 嗯，几乎所有人都赢。

lines.en: : Frankly, there are several girls I’m quite worried about when it comes to how many helpings of misery they’re piling onto their lunch trays.
lines.zh: : 说实话，有几个女孩让我很担心——我担心她们往自己的午餐盘里堆了多少苦难。

lines.en: : Would you mind explaining what you mean by that?
lines.zh: : 你能解释一下这是什么意思吗？

lines.en: : What I mean is that not everyone is smart enough to really understand what you’re doing here, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，不是每个人都聪明到能真正理解你在这里做什么，老师。

lines.en: : And that there are plenty of people who would sooner do something stupid than confront you with their issues as I’m doing right now.
lines.zh: : 而且有很多人宁愿做点蠢事，也不愿像我现在这样，把自己的问题摊开来跟你谈。

lines.en: : You should be happy I’m not one of those people.
lines.zh: : 你该庆幸我不是那种人。

lines.en: : And how should I feel about the others?
lines.zh: : 那我该怎么看待其他人？

lines.en: scene makotounderstars11
: I suppose that depends on how far things have already gone with them.
lines.zh: : 我想那取决于你跟她们已经走到哪一步了。

lines.en: : ...Which means?
lines.zh: : ……意思是？

lines.en: : Which means that if you’ve already done with them as you’ve done with me, it’s going to be exponentially harder for them to confront the hardships that are certain to befall them.
lines.zh: : 意思是，如果你对她们做过像对我做过的事，那她们要面对必然会降临的苦难，难度会成倍增加。

lines.en: scene makotounderstars12
: The amount of pain in this world is unfathomable at times.
lines.zh: : 这世界上的痛苦有时深不可测。

lines.en: : And you’re like a vessel flying over all of us, leaking that pain out and letting it drip into our mouths as we stare up at beautiful, colorful, world ending skies.
lines.zh: : 而你就像一艘飞过我们所有人的飞船，把那些痛苦泄漏出来，让它一滴滴落进我们嘴里，而我们正仰望着那片绚丽多彩、世界末日般的天空。

lines.en: scene makotounderstars13
: Sensei-
lines.zh: : 老师——

lines.en: : What would it take to have you drop all of them and be with only me?
lines.zh: : 要怎样做，你才会抛下她们所有人，只和我在一起？

lines.en: : Pardon me for my sudden selfishness, but I’m genuinely curious about whether something like that would even be possible.
lines.zh: : 请原谅我突然的自私，但我真的很好奇，那种事到底有没有可能。

lines.en: : I deserve it, don’t I?
lines.zh: : 这是我应得的，不是吗？

lines.en: : Is there anyone you know that has done as much for you as I have?
lines.zh: : 你认识的人里，有谁像我这样为你做了这么多吗？

lines.en: : I mean...Ami has been cooking and cleaning for me since-
lines.zh: : 我是说……Ami 一直在给我做饭、打扫，从——

lines.zh: 还有另一个人。

lines.en: scene makotoclass
scene makotolocker7

scene makotobeach
: I should have expected as much.
lines.zh: : 我早该料到。

lines.en: : Asking you to give up the others for someone like me is laughable when I’ve only just started to spread my wings.
lines.zh: : 在我才刚刚开始展开翅膀的时候，就要求你为了我这样的人放弃其他人，实在可笑。

lines.en: : But they’ll continue to spread, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 但它们会继续展开的，老师。

lines.en: : They’ll spread so wide that they’ll cover the world and block out the sun.
lines.zh: : 它们会展开得那么宽，遮住整个世界，把太阳都挡住。

lines.en: : They’ll block out everything.
lines.zh: : 它们会把一切全都挡住。

lines.en: : And then you’ll {i}have{/i} to look at me.
lines.zh: : 到那时，你就{i}不得不{/i}看着我了。

lines.en: : But, for now-
lines.zh: : 不过，现在——

lines.en: : I suppose there’s nothing else I can do.
lines.zh: : 我想我也别无他法了。

lines.en: I’m not here.
lines.zh: 我不在这里。

lines.en: Well, I {i}am{/i} here.
lines.zh: 好吧，我{i}是{/i}在这里。

lines.en: But I’m not here.
lines.zh: 但我不在这里。

lines.en: I feel far away from something.
lines.zh: 我觉得自己离某个东西很远。

lines.en: I feel hands on my shoulders, pulling me backwards.
lines.zh: 我感觉到有手搭在我肩上，把我往后拉。

lines.en: I feel frayed wires wrapped around my ankles, scratching me enough to draw blood but not to sever my Achilles tendons.
lines.zh: 我感觉到磨损的铁丝缠在我的脚踝上，刮得我出血，却还不足以割断我的跟腱。

lines.en: : Do you feel that, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你感觉到了吗，老师？

lines.en: : Feel what?
lines.zh: : 感觉到什么？

lines.en: : A...minor earthquake, maybe?
lines.zh: : 一次……小型地震，也许？

lines.en: : I thought I felt the ground shaking, but it was probably just a wave crashing down or something.
lines.zh: : 我以为感觉到地面在晃，但大概只是浪拍下来之类的。

lines.en: The ocean is still, though.
lines.zh: 可海面很平静。

lines.en: There are no waves anywhere to be found.
lines.zh: 到处都找不到浪。

lines.en: : Oh, I did a little more digging on this Yasu Yasui character, by the way.
lines.zh: : 哦，顺便说一句，关于这个 Yasu Yasui 我多查了一点。

lines.en: : I don’t know why it never occurred to me to just ask the other girls from Kumon-mi Academy, but several of them knew her.
lines.zh: : 我不知道为什么我从没想过直接去问 Kumon-mi 学园的其他女生，不过有好几个认识她。

lines.en: : Namely Uta and Noriko.
lines.zh: : 主要是 Uta 和 Noriko。

lines.en: : Figures that the talkative ones would know her.
lines.zh: : 果然是话多的那几个认识她。

lines.en: : I suppose. Neither of them seemed to know her all that well, though.
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。不过她们俩似乎都不太了解她。

lines.en: : Apparently, she didn’t attend normal classes on account of her...behavior. So I’m now worrying that we really {i}will{/i} have another Yumi on our hands before we know it.
lines.zh: : 据说她因为……行为问题，不上正常的课。所以我现在开始担心，我们真的很快{i}又要{/i}多出一个 Yumi 了。

lines.en: : Did they say anything about how cute she is by any chance?
lines.zh: : 她们有没有顺便提到她有多可爱？

lines.en: : Really? You’re going to ask that now? After I {i}just{/i} finished telling you about how I want you to look at me more?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？你现在还问这个？我{i}刚{/i}说完想让你多看看我。

lines.en: : This doesn’t count as me being mean, does it?
lines.zh: : 这不算我刻薄吧，对吗？

lines.en: : It...kind of does.
lines.zh: : 那个……算是吧。

lines.en: : Oh. Well then I guess I can just find out when she transfers in.
lines.zh: : 哦。那我大概只能等她转学过来的时候再知道了。

lines.en: : I...guess so.
lines.zh: : 我……大概吧。

lines.en: : Can I ask you one more thing before we head back, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 回去之前我还能再问你一件事吗，老师？

lines.en: : You weren’t kidding about wanting to talk a lot this weekend, were you?
lines.zh: : 你说这个周末想多聊聊，还真不是开玩笑啊？

lines.en: : No, I was not. But there’s been something else on my mind that I haven’t really had a chance to ask you about.
lines.zh: : 是，我没开玩笑。不过我心里还有另一件事，一直没机会问你。

lines.en: : And what is that?
lines.zh: : 是什么事？

lines.en: : Well...I looked into Noriko’s background after she transferred in and wound up speaking with her parents.
lines.zh: : 嗯……Noriko 转学过来之后，我查了她的背景，最后还跟她父母谈了谈。

lines.en: : Well that’s not creepy or an invasion of privacy by any means.
lines.zh: : 这可一点都不瘆人，也算不上侵犯隐私。

lines.en: : Can you let me finish, please?
lines.zh: : 你能让我说完吗？

lines.en: : I wound up speaking with them and they definitely remember you, so her story checks out.
lines.zh: : 我最后跟他们谈了，他们确实记得你，所以她的说法站得住脚。

lines.en: : But I...
lines.zh: : 不过我……

lines.en: : ...You what?
lines.zh: : ……你什么？

lines.en: : I also looked into Maya as well because...I was curious about their apparent...{i}connection{/i} with one another.
lines.zh: : 我也查了 Maya，因为……我很好奇她们之间那种显而易见的……{i}联系{/i}。

lines.en: : Maya spends a good deal of time at your house, correct? I know her and Ami are close, so it would only make sense if she did.
lines.zh: : Maya 有很多时间待在你家，对吧？我知道她和 Ami 关系很好，所以如果真是那样也说得通。

lines.en: : Yeah. It’s basically a second home for her, I guess.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我想那基本算是她的第二个家。

lines.en: : I thought so...But would you have happened to speak with any of her family in the past, by any chance?
lines.zh: : 我想也是……不过你过去有没有碰巧跟她的家人说过话？

lines.en: : Because all of the phone numbers on record for her are either disconnected or simply made up.
lines.zh: : 因为她档案上登记的所有电话号码，要么是空号，要么干脆是编的。

lines.en: : For Maya?
lines.zh: : Maya 的？

lines.en: : Yeah. I mean, it’s possible that it’s just outdated paperwork, but...it seems strange.
lines.zh: : 对。我是说，也许只是过时的文件，但……总感觉很奇怪。

lines.en: : All I really know is that she’s not originally from here.
lines.zh: : 我唯一知道的就是，她本来不是这里的人。

lines.en: : Ahh. Well I suppose that would probably explain it.
lines.zh: : 啊。我想这大概就能解释了。

lines.en: : Sometimes, files get mixed up when students switch municipal districts, so it probably just got lost in the shuffle somewhere.
lines.zh: : 学生跨市辖区转学时，档案有时会弄混，所以大概只是在某个环节弄丢了。

lines.en: : It’s no big deal, I suppose. I’ll just ask her for updated information soon.
lines.zh: : 我想没什么大不了的。我过阵子直接跟她要最新的信息就好了。

lines.en: : Oh, and is it true that you dated Niki Nakayama?
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，你和 Niki Nakayama 交往过是真的吗？

lines.en: if otohapark1 == True or saradate10 == True:
: Yeah, that’s true.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是真的。

lines.en: : Want me to call her and confirm that for you? She loves when I do that.
lines.zh: : 要我打电话给你确认一下吗？她最喜欢我这么干了。

lines.en: : What? No. That won’t be necessary. I have no reason to doubt you since I heard it directly from Noriko’s parents.
lines.zh: : 什么？不。没必要。我是直接从 Noriko 父母那儿听来的，没理由怀疑你。

lines.en: : But that’s really surprising. I didn’t take you as the type to be into nice, pretty girls like her.
lines.zh: : 不过真让人意外。我没看出来你会喜欢她那种又温柔又漂亮的女孩。

lines.en: else:
: Yeah, that’s true.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是真的。

lines.en: : That’s really surprising. I didn’t take you as the type to be into nice, pretty girls like her.
lines.zh: : 真让人意外。我没看出来你会喜欢她那种又温柔又漂亮的女孩。

lines.en: : Pretty, sure. But I can assure you that Niki is anything but nice.
lines.zh: : 漂亮，那是。但我可以向你保证，Niki 绝对谈不上温柔。

lines.en: : Really? But she seems so kind on TV.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？可她在电视上看起来那么亲切。

lines.en: : She’s kind of like what would happen if Yumi became really stuck up and started chewing unhealthy amounts of bubblegum.
lines.zh: : 她差不多就是 Yumi 变得极其自以为是、还开始嚼着不健康分量的泡泡糖之后的样子。

lines.en: : Wow. I guess that whole thing about celebrities not being who you expect them to be is true then.
lines.zh: : 哇。看来「名人跟你想象的不一样」这件事是真的了。

lines.en: : Anything else you were curious about or can we start heading back now? It’s getting cold.
lines.zh: : 还有别的好奇的吗，还是我们现在就往回走？天冷起来了。

lines.en: : We can start heading back.
lines.zh: : 我们可以往回走了。

lines.en: : We’re going to have to be quiet when we walk in, though, since Miku is probably asleep by now.
lines.zh: : 不过我们进去的时候得安静点，因为 Miku 这会儿大概已经睡了。

lines.en: : Already? I figured she’d be the type to stay up until like 3:00 AM.
lines.zh: : 已经睡了？我还以为她是那种会熬到凌晨三点的类型。

lines.en: : Oh, lord no. She’ll be out like a light. But she wakes up very easily, so we’ll need to be really quiet while getting dressed.
lines.zh: : 哦，天哪，不会。她一沾枕头就睡死。但她很容易醒，所以我们换衣服的时候得特别安静。

lines.en: : I guess that means there’s no chance for a nightcap then?
lines.zh: : 那看来是没机会来点睡前酒了？

lines.en: : Are you seriously this horny all of the time? I think you might have some sort of condition, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你真的无时无刻都这么饥渴吗？我觉得你可能是得了什么病，老师。

lines.en: : We should take you to the doctor once we get back home.
lines.zh: : 等我们回去，该带你去看医生了。

lines.en: : My feelings for you are not a sickness, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 我对你的感情不是病，Makoto。

lines.en: : Ugh...
: At least wait until we get back to the dorm to say things like that...
lines.zh: : 至少等我们回宿舍再说这种话……

lines.en: scene black
Makoto and I make our way back to the inn.
lines.zh: Makoto 和我往旅馆走回去。

lines.en: Halfway there, snow begins to fall.
lines.zh: 走到一半，下起了雪。

$ makoto_love += 1

lines.zh: {i}Makoto 的好感度提升到了 [makoto_love]！{/i}
